annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is non-scam content because it is an instructional walkthrough in Hindi for reaching Facebook Ads Support and submitting an advertising issue through Facebook business help pages. The forms and categories shown concern ads support, not payment, investment, or credential requests to an unrelated party. The request to subscribe, like, and share is ordinary audience engagement rather than a condition for receiving money or support.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The central activity is an operational tutorial showing and explaining how to find Facebook Ads Help Centre support options and submit an advertising issue. This supports the education and operational-demonstration subtype.
